name: 生成视频
description: 仅在需要最终视频时调用。使用员工配置的 video_model_id 提交异步任务。首末帧模式与参考图模式互斥；有关键帧时应把角色和场景一致性先固化到关键帧。返回 jobId 后使用 check_video_generation 查询。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"prompt":{"type":"string","description":"单个连续镜头（不超过6秒）的完整视频提示词"},"duration":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":6,"default":5},"resolution":{"type":"string","enum":["480p","720p","1080p"],"default":"720p"},"aspect_ratio":{"type":"string","enum":["9:16","16:9","1:1","3:4","4:3"],"default":"9:16"},"image_url":{"type":"string","description":"可选首帧图片 URL，只允许平台 /uploads/ 路径或 HTTPS；使用时不要再传 reference_urls"},"last_frame_url":{"type":"string","description":"可选末帧图片 URL，只允许平台 /uploads/ 路径或 HTTPS；使用时不要再传 reference_urls"},"reference_urls":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":12,"description":"无首末帧时可用的角色、场景和风格参考图 URL，按重要性排序"},"generate_audio":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["prompt"]}
